primary_guidance: EAU prostate-cancer guideline limited update March2026,anatomical staging and MRI/biopsy risk context
corrections: Outdated39-sector teaching replaced by41-region localization with38+2+1 composition.
Size criteria qualified by suspicious sequence morphology or specified definite invasion.
Haemorrhage-exclusion sign and low T2 seminal-vesicle appearances kept as imaging evidence,not confirmed histology.
PSA-density calculation preserved; universal0.15 biopsy trigger removed.
MRI extent,TNM anatomical definitions,DRE-based cT and pathology separated; automatic treatment assumptions removed.
Measurement uses ADC forPZ,T2 forTZ,documented fallback; four lesions is not an absolute cap; index ties useEPE then size.
Device susceptibility example explicitly requires manufacturer-approved liquid fill.
Reasoning diagram and model instructions declare conceptual/incomplete anatomy.
Teaching report template prompts actual acquired/derived sequences,unobtained DCE and quality rather than preasserting a full protocol.
remaining_media_gaps: Original source gland/ROI and selected MRI references do not provide every fine zonal,ductal,neurovascular,sphincter,nodal or pathological interface.
